mapper.select: SELECT T.username, T.nickname, T.password, T.enabled, R.authority, UO.ORGANIZATION_ID AS orgId, T.TENANT_ID AS tenantId, T.EXPIRED_TIME FROM LA_USERS T LEFT JOIN LA_USER_ROLES UR ON UR.USERNAME = T.username LEFT JOIN LA_ROLES R ON R.authority = UR.authority AND R.enabled = 1 LEFT JOIN LA_USER_ORGANIZATION UO ON UO.USERNAME = T.username WHERE T.username = #{username}

SELECT T.username, T.nickname, T.password, T.enabled, R.authority, UO.ORGANIZATION_ID AS orgid, T.TENANT_ID AS tenantId, T.EXPIRED_TIME FROM LA_USERS T LEFT JOIN LA_USER_ROLES UR ON UR.USERNAME = T.username LEFT JOIN LA_ROLES R ON R.authority = UR.authority AND R.enabled = 1 LEFT JOIN LA_USER_ORGANIZATION UO ON UO.USERNAME = T.username WHERE T.mobile = #{mobile}
SELECT U.username, U.nickname FROM LA_USER_ROLES UR INNER JOIN LA_USERS U ON U.USERNAME = UR.USERNAME AND UR.AUTHORITY = #{roleId}

SELECT R.ID FROM LA_RESOURCES R WHERE R.RES_TYPE = 3 AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM LA_ROLE_RESOURCES RR WHERE RR.RESOURCE_ID = R.ID AND RR.AUTHORITY IN (SELECT AUTHORITY FROM LA_USER_ROLES WHERE USERNAME = #{username} UNION SELECT ORG_R.AUTHORITY FROM LA_ORGANIZATION_ROLES ORG_R INNER JOIN LA_USER_ORGANIZATION UO ON ORG_R.ORGANIZATION_ID = UO.ORGANIZATION_ID WHERE UO.USERNAME = #{username})) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM LA_ORGANIZATION_RESOURCES ORG_RES INNER JOIN LA_USER_ORGANIZATION UO ON ORG_RES.ORGANIZATION_ID = UO.ORGANIZATION_ID WHERE ORG_RES.RESOURCE_ID = R.ID AND UO.USERNAME = #{username}) )
